name: cross-platform-app
description: One codebase for web (PWA), desktop and mobile: a Rust engine compiled to WebAssembly and to native, a TypeScript/React UI, Tauri 2 shells. Static web hosting on Vercel, native apps from GitHub Releases. No backend.

board.title: Roadmap and status
board.body: The living index of what is done, in progress and next. Keep it short: link the issues and `docs/` pages instead of copying them. The first task (issue #3) fills it in.

ruleVars.LOCAL_CHECKS: `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test` (Rust and TypeScript; 1-3 min cold, faster warm; CI also runs the WebAssembly build and the smoke test). `npm run build` only if you touched `crates/wasm`, `packages/engine-client`, the Vite config, `apps/web/public/sw.js` or how the engine is loaded.
ruleVars.AFTER_MERGE: A merge to `main` deploys the web app by itself (CI job `deploy-web` runs after `verify` is green, only when app code changed). Native apps ship from version tags (`DEPLOYING.md`). Do NOT deploy, tag or release unless the owner asked, and do not wait. Check production only if the task needs it.
ruleVars.HOTFIX_LINE: A release is a version tag made only when the owner asks.
ruleVars.HOTFIX_FIX: tell the owner if a released build is affected
ruleVars.SESSION_DEPLOY: never deploy or tag a release unless asked (CI deploys the web app after merge)
